reel:
Day 3 without UPI and your corner sabziwala can't sell you even one tomato. What if UPI stopped working for a week?
Gone.
82 crore UPI payments a day just stop, and his customers stopped carrying cash years ago. So they walk past. The delivery rider paid every evening? Nothing. The cook in Mumbai sending money home to her village? Stuck.
Full story on YouTube, digital payments and all.
Honestly, how much cash is in your wallet right now? Tell me in the comments.
#whatif #upi #digitalpayments #india
short:
82 crore UPI payments a day, gone for 7 days, and you can't even buy a ₹10 chai. What if UPI stopped working?
Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm. All fail. The apps aren't UPI, they're just doors to one house run by NPCI, and that house is closed. Your card mostly works. Your kirana? QR sticker only.
Full story on YouTube, digital payments and all.
Would you last a week on the cash in your wallet? Tell me in the comments.
#whatif #upi #upidown #india
